neighbours.label: In a list of school sectors (public, district, magnet ...), the slot just before a further school type is named, typically the ' and' before 'charter schools'; its output promotes ' charter'/' magnet'
fire: The state now pays the same amount per pupil to district, magnet and charter schools.
Enrollment rose last year in traditional public, magnet and charter schools across the county.
The survey compared test scores at neighborhood public schools and charter schools in four cities.
Families in the city may apply to public, parochial and charter schools through one form.
The new law covers every public, magnet and charter school that receives state money.
Researchers followed students in district-run public schools and charter schools for six years.
The board oversees a mix of traditional, magnet and charter schools on the east side.
Funding for buses is shared among public, private and charter schools in the valley.
quiet: The state now pays the same amount per pupil for books, meals and transport.
Enrollment rose last year in biology, chemistry and physics courses across the county.
The survey compared test scores of fourth graders and eighth graders in four cities.
Families in the city may apply for lunches, bus passes and tutoring through one form.
The new law covers every teacher, nurse and librarian who is paid with state money.
Researchers followed students with reading difficulties and their parents for six years.
The board oversees a mix of budgets, building projects and hiring on the east side.
Funding for buses is shared among towns, villages and farms in the valley.

notes: Card: peaks on ' and'/' a' right before charter/voluntary-aided/virtual schools; - pole output promotes ' charter', ' magnet'. Probes: 'district, magnet and charter schools' 0.93, 'public schools and charter schools' 0.62; but 'math, science and art classes' 0.33 and 'public schools and private tutors' 0.42, so near misses that keep the school topic may leak.
